prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D tree sprite atlas for a high-quality hand-painted medieval fantasy strategy map, rendered in an interactive Three.js 2.5D landscape.
Create EXACTLY EIGHT isolated full tree illustrations in an evenly spaced 4-column by 2-row grid, equal rectangular cells. Transparent background across the entire canvas, generous transparent gutters, NO ground, no base discs, no drop shadows outside trees, no text, no borders.
Top row: four different lush deciduous trees, mature oak, rounded beech, spreading elm, slender birch-like tree. Bottom row: two more deciduous trees followed by TWO CONIFERS (fir and spruce) in the two rightmost cells. Each tree occupies nearly its whole cell height, base of trunk aligned close to bottom of its own cell, no trees touching adjacent cells. All trees fully visible.
Art direction: reproduce the richly illustrated forests of the supplied fantasy atlas reference: finely painted clusters of LEAVES, layered irregular canopies, tiny stippled foliage texture, intricate branch silhouettes, golden olive and sage lit leaves, very dark forest-green undersides, visible narrow warm brown trunk. Conifers have detailed broken needles and uneven branching tiers, not plain geometric cones. Naturalistic cartographic illustration viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter perspective, flat orthographic view of each tree, coherent warm sunlight from upper left. Rich ink-and-gouache craft, elegant delicate edge detail, high resolution. NOT low-poly 3D, not cartoon bubble trees, not rounded plastic balls, not photorealistic photos. Detailed tree crowns must read clearly at small map scales. Landscape canvas proportions 2:1, four columns by two rows. TRUE transparent alpha background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tiled hand-painted ground material for the plains of an illustrated medieval fantasy atlas. Pure flat orthographic TOP-DOWN material texture, square canvas. Continuous varied meadow greens and straw ochres, elegant fine pen-and-gouache hatching, minute grasses and clover-like mottling, soft warm earth glimpses, organically patchy vegetation and attractive drawing detail. Directionless surface detail suitable for repeating over a 3D landscape. Palette matches the supplied fantasy cartography reference: luminous subdued golden grass, muted sage greens, moss and olive, restrained warm ochre. Fine organic strokes, intentional delicate illustration craft, no harsh contrast or obvious repetitive feature. Edges must tile seamlessly. NO trees, rivers, lakes, mountains, buildings, roads, perspective, cast shadows, labels or objects. Texture only, no composition or landscape scene. Not a photograph, not low-poly, not plastic, not uniform noise.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tiled hand-painted rock material for rugged mountain ridges in an illustrated medieval fantasy atlas. Square, flat material texture with no perspective. Rich fine ink and gouache geological drawing: layered fractured limestone and slate, fine angular cracks and mineral grain, uneven strata, craggy planes picked out in warm pale grey, muted ochre-grey, sage-grey shadows and light ivory highlights. Small moss traces only in crevices. This must resemble the detailed drawn mountain rock faces in the supplied atlas reference, and will be projected across a continuous 3D mountain surface. Directionless overall lighting, no pronounced baked directional shadows, seamless matching edges, moderate local contrast with plenty of subtle detailed hatch marks. NO mountain silhouettes, landscape composition, snowcaps, ground planes, trees, rivers, buildings, words, labels or border. Only a repeatable painterly mineral surface, not photorealistic and not a 3D low-poly render.
